title: Hindi
description: ISC Class XI Hindi language and prescribed texts.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ISC Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Indian Languages (February 2025 document) and Appendix I - List of Prescribed Textbooks, HINDI (805) (www.cisce.org).
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026 against the CISCE-copyrighted 'ISC YEAR 2027 / INDIAN SCHOOL CERTIFICATE EXAMINATION / INDIAN LANGUAGES, February 2025' document (page footers 'ISC Examination Year 2027', CISCE copyright notice, mission statement) read through a reproduction because cisce.org returns 403 to automated fetches; the companion Appendix I gives the entry 'HINDI (805)', correcting the subject code 853 that a secondary page had claimed (853 is Geography). Corroboration: a CISCE circular dated 12 February 2025 announcing the Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses, and the Oswal Publishers ISC Class XI Hindi page reproducing the same two-paper structure and the same four prescribed texts. Class XI prescribes Paper I Theory (3 hours, 80 marks) with Section A Language (40 marks: composition of about 400 words, unseen passage of about 300 words with questions and/or summary, functional grammar) and Section B Prescribed Textbooks (40 marks: four questions from any three prescribed textbooks), plus Paper II Project Work (20 marks: Listening 6, Speaking 6, Writing 8, internally assessed). The document states 'The Class XI Examination is to be conducted on the portion of this syllabus that is covered during the academic year' and 'The CISCE has not prescribed bifurcation of the syllabus prescribed for this subject', so the registered units below are the syllabus's own sections and its four prescribed texts and no further split is claimed. Limitation: the official page could not be fetched (403); publishers label the 2026-27 session as sitting the ISC 2028 framework, a cycle discrepancy this project has recorded for every ISC XI subject rather than resolved.

sections.title: Hindi (Paper I)
sections.paperLabel: ISC Class XI · Paper I · Theory (80 marks)
sections.description: Section A Language (40 marks) and Section B Prescribed Textbooks (40 marks).

chapters.title: Language: Composition, Comprehension and Grammar
chapters.blurb: The compulsory Section A of the theory paper: a composition of approximately 400 words from a choice of six topics, an unseen passage of about 300 words with questions and/or a summary, and functional grammar covering sentence structure with agreement of subject and verb in number, gender, case, tense and voice.

chapters.title: Saara Akash (Novel) — Rajendra Yadav
chapters.blurb: The prescribed novel, offered as one of the three textbooks from which the four Section B questions are set.

chapters.title: Aashad Ka Ek Din (Drama) — Mohan Rakesh
chapters.blurb: The prescribed drama, offered as one of the three textbooks from which the four Section B questions are set.

chapters.title: Gadya Sanklan (Short Stories and Essays)
chapters.blurb: The prescribed ISC collection of short stories and essays published by Evergreen Publications: Puthra Prem, Gauri, Sharanagat, Sati, Outsider, Dasi, Kya Nirash Hua Jai, Bhaktin, Sanskriti Hai Kya and Majburi.

chapters.title: Kavya Manjari (Poems)
chapters.blurb: The prescribed ISC collection of poems published by Evergreen Publications: Sakhi, Balleela, Ek Phool Ki Chah, Aah Dharati Kitna Deti Hai, Nadi Ke Dweep, Tulsi Das Ke Pad, Jag Tujhko Door Jana Hai, Udyami Nar, Badal Ko Ghirte Dekha Hai and Andhere Ka Deepak.

sections.title: Project Work
sections.paperLabel: ISC Class XI · Paper II · Project Work (20 marks)
sections.description: Project work in Listening, Speaking and Writing, assessed internally by the school.

chapters.title: Project Work: Listening, Speaking and Writing
chapters.blurb: The internally assessed project work of 20 marks: Listening (6), Speaking (6) and Writing (8), with three projects taken over the year from the assignments the syllabus lists for each skill.
